## Slice contract

What coherent behavior/infrastructure change does this PR make?

## Why now

Which roadmap phase or defect justifies the change?

## Ownership / architecture

- [ ] New cross-system state has one authoritative owner.
- [ ] No new global/Autoload was added without explicit justification.
- [ ] Simulation does not depend on UI.
- [ ] UI does not become authoritative gameplay state.
- [ ] Project-wide architecture changes have an ADR.

## Health

- [ ] Architecture guard passes.
- [ ] Godot import succeeds.
- [ ] Automated tests pass.
- [ ] Main scene boots.
- [ ] `docs/state.md` reflects reality.
- [ ] Canon/roadmap docs changed only if their truth changed.

## Build / owner recovery

- [ ] Windows preview artifact succeeds when owner-facing testing is relevant.
- [ ] Build/debug identity remains visible and copyable.
- [ ] Generated build outputs are not committed.

## Persistence

- [ ] No save-schema change.
- [ ] OR schema/migration/fixtures were updated deliberately.

## Owner-facing result

Describe what the non-coding project owner should test or observe.
